metadata.description: KnowledgeFactory CLI — AI-powered capture-to-publish pipeline for Obsidian. Capture any public/shareable video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, Zoom recordings, Twitch, TikTok, and any yt-dlp-supported site), articles, repos, and ideas into structured notes. Auto-detects instructional vs meeting video, auto-tags, wiki-indexes, and publishes. No Docker or MCP required.
